title: 'Amayo no Tsuki' Reveals Main Cast, Additional Staff, First Promo, 2027 Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kuzushiro 's Amayo no Tsuki ( The Moon on a Rainy Night ) manga revealed the main cast, additional staff, and the first promotional video on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Moon on a Rainy Night Reveals First Trailer, Main Cast
content: The previously announced The Moon on a Rainy Night anime revealed its first trailer along with the main cast on Wednesday. title: Live-Action Can You Kiss Me First? Series' Teaser Reveals Theme Song
content: The official website for the live-action series of Yamayade 's Can You Kiss Me First? ( Omae no Hou kara Kiss Shitekure yo ) boys' love manga presented a new teaser trailer for the series on Wednesday. The teaser announces and previews the series' theme song "Shiranai" (I Don't Know) by Urashimasakatasen .
author: ANN

title: 5 More Critically Acclaimed Anime Crunchyroll Removed & You Can’t Stream Anywhere Else
content: There’s no de Crunchyroll is the largest streaming platform for anime fans across the world, home to over a thousand series and movies. Each year, the platform adds a few dozen new releases to make them more accessible for fans.

title: The Apothecary Diaries Is Getting a New Shojo Competitor Soon
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is the biggest quarter of the year, and most of the credit goes to the return of major shows. This also includes The Apothecary Diaries Season 3, which has been growing in popularity ever since its premiere in 2023.
author: ComicBook

title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Manga Goes on 1-Week Hiatus Due to Creator's Health
content: This year's 45th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine announced on Wednesday that Masakuni Igarashi 's Tune In to the Midnight Heart ( Mayonaka Heart Tune ) manga does not have a new chapter in the issue as initially planned, due to Igarashi getting sick.
author: ANN

title: Kai-hen Wizards Manga to Publish 'Series Finale' on October 14
content: This year's 45th issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday announced on Wednesday that Yellow Tanabe 's Kai-hen Wizards ( Kaihen no Mahōtsukai ) manga will publish its "series finale chapter" in the magazine's next issue on October 14. The expanded chapter will have 26 pages.
author: ANN

title: 10 Years Ago Today, Jujutsu Kaisen Studio Premiered an Anime That Saved Its Future Before Its Cancellation
content: Established in 2011, the renowned animation studio MAPPA eventually became one of the biggest in the industry after creating famous shows such as Jujutsu Kaisen and Chainsaw Man . However, 2016 was the breakthrough year for the studio after their sports anime, Yuri!!! on Ice became massively popular.

title: Toshiaki Yamada's Tokyo Duel Manga Ends
content: Coamix 's Comic Zenon + manga website published the final chapter of Toshiaki Yamada 's Tokyo Duel ( Tokyo Kettō Kanjōsen ) manga on September 23. The final chapter became free to read on Wednesday. Coamix publishes the manga volumes in English digitally.
author: ANN
